summary: Shen Feizhi deals with the aftermath of his intimate encounter with Gu Suizhou, who continues to exhibit possessive and clingy behavior, including shackling Shen Feizhi at night. Gu Suizhou reveals he has discovered their pheromone compatibility is 100%, which causes him internal turmoil as he feels Shen Feizhi does not reciprocate his feelings. Gu Suizhou seeks advice from his friend Leapton on how to be more direct. Shen Feizhi prepares to visit the Prosecutor's Office to claim his inheritance, specifically looking for scientific equipment for Gu Suizhou's company, while struggling with the increasingly blurred boundaries of their relationship.
